summary: Apache OpenMeetings: self-hosted Java web-conferencing/meeting suite. JPA entities for users, groups, rooms, calendar appointments, file storage (om_file), recordings, invitations/polls, config, chat, email-queue, plus CXF JAX-RS REST webservices under /services/* authenticated per-call by session id (BaseWebService.performCall -> Sessiondata + User.Right). Write path: DAO layer in openmeetings-db/.../dao.
